posts.title: Dirty South Keeps Winning While Nobody Watches
posts.author: Commissioner
body: Dirty South has won five in a row and the league has mostly declined to notice. Week 7 should fix that. Joe Burrow went for **32.88**, Quinshon Judkins added **22.4**, Jameson Williams **21.1** and CeeDee Lamb **19.4**, and the final was **139.28 to 82.82** over the BIG Kahunas, a **56.46** margin and the largest of the week. Kyle Ryan's contribution to the evening was starting the San Francisco defense for **0** and Jalen Coker for **0.9** while Jacoby Brissett (**17.48**), Omar Cooper Jr. (**17.5**), Blake Corum (**16.1**) and KC Concepcion Jr. (**15.2**) watched from the bench. The Kahunas have now lost two straight after winning four in a row.

The ShenHgts Skidmarks scored **58.30**. That is the lowest total anyone has put up in the league since week 6 and the third-lowest score of the entire 2026 season. Patrick Mahomes gave Mikita **6.00**, Derrick Henry **4.9**, A.J. Brown **4.8** and Sam LaPorta **1.8**. Dak Prescott sat on the bench for **26.28**, Cairo Santos for **15** and Saquon Barkley for **13.1**. Jersey Devil Dogz did not have to do anything special to win **103.40 to 58.30** and did not — Rhamondre Stevenson **17.5**, Ollie Gordon II **16.3**, Amon-Ra St. Brown **15.2**. Chubby is **6-1** and alone at the top. Mark has lost three straight and remains the owner of the most decorated résumé in league history with exactly one ring on it, from 2007, under a different team name.

The two games that mattered were decided by a combined **5.46** points. Mexican Mafia beat Bird Gang **115.94 to 112.72** on the back of Tony Pollard's **33.5** and Drake Maye's **29.44**, with Trey McBride chipping in **17.1**. Bird Gang got **23** from Bucky Irving, **21.02** from Jared Goff and **19.7** from Zay Flowers and lost anyway, because Kenneth Walker III (**5.7**) and Jordan Mason (**6.8**) combined for less than a kicker. One year after going **14-0**, the defending champion is **3-4**. In the other, Sponge Bobs took Silver Stars **90.72 to 88.48** for their third straight win — Tee Higgins **20.8**, Christian McCaffrey **16**, Josh Jacobs **15.1** — while Justin Silver started Garrett Wilson for **2.6** and Isaiah Likely for **1.2**. Haven Boyz handled Brendawg21 **97.72 to 90.90** behind Caleb Williams (**24.12**) and Javonte Williams (**21.5**).

The standings are a mess in the middle. Jersey Devil Dogz **6-1**, Dirty South **5-2**, then Silver Stars and BIG Kahunas at **4-3**, then five teams — Bird Gang, Mexican Mafia, ShenHgts, Sponge Bobs, Haven Boyz — stacked at **3-4**. Brendawg21 is **1-6**. Six of ten make the playoffs, which means one of those five gets in on a tiebreaker and the other four spend December explaining themselves. Seven weeks remain.

Two numbers worth sitting with. Silver Stars lead the league with **837.34** points scored and are **4-3**, a full **119.62** per week, which is the pace of a team that should be running away with this. And Brendan has scored **704.94** points — more than the **696.70** that has Jersey Devil Dogz in first place — and is **1-6**, having allowed a league-high **809.12**. That is not bad management. That is the schedule deciding it does not like you. No all-time marks moved this week; nothing came close.

posts.title: The Kahunas Find a New Floor
posts.author: Commissioner
body: Kyle Ryan's BIG Kahunas scored **54.02**. In a week where the league averaged **88.75** points a team, the lowest output of the season, the Kahunas managed to be their own category. Their leading starter was kicker Spencer Shrader at **9.00**. Bijan Robinson gave them **5.30**, Kyren Williams **6.70**, Jacoby Brissett **6.92** at quarterback. Blake Corum sat on the bench with **12.00**, which is more than any Kahuna who actually played. Ron Wasilewski's Sponge Bobs needed **87.16** to win by **33.14**, got **22.70** from Christian McCaffrey and **18.36** from Brock Purdy, and have now won two straight after opening 0-4.

Bird Gang handed the Jersey Devil Dogz their first loss of the year, **105.04 to 94.70**. Trevor Lawrence went for **31.34**, Kenneth Walker added **25.90**, and Bhayshul Tuten chipped in **20.70** — three starters doing the work of a full lineup, which was necessary, because the other six combined for **27.10**. Chubby Ryan got **23.00** from Jayden Daniels and **16.40** from Matthew Golden and still went home. The Devil Dogz are **5-1** and sit first, which is a nice place to be for a team ranked sixth in the league in points scored.

Dirty South beat the Silver Stars **99.54 to 90.80** for their fourth consecutive win after an 0-2 start. Jordan Love (**21.24**), James Cook (**21.30**) and Chris Boswell (**18.00**) did enough, and Erik Marnell left Kyle Pitts and his **18.00** on the bench without being punished for it. Justin Silver was less lucky. He lost by **8.74** while Tyler Shough put up **29.96** in street clothes. The Silver Stars have scored **748.86** points, more than anyone in the league by **57.92**, and have two losses to show for it. That is a particular kind of season, and Justin has had it before.

Haven Boyz handled the Skidmarks **100.90 to 66.68**, the widest margin of the week at **34.22**. Jonathan Taylor went for **20.10** and Caleb Williams **17.50**. Mark Mikita countered with **10.48** from Patrick Mahomes, **5.00** from Derrick Henry and **1.00** from Brandon Aubrey, and has now dropped two in a row. And Brendan Ryan finally won a football game. Brendawg21 took down the Mexican Mafia **103.98 to 84.70** behind Malik Nabers (**16.50**), Matthew Stafford (**18.88**) and DeVonta Smith (**13.50**), ending an 0-5 start. Alberto Ruiz got **26.80** from Drake Maye and lost by **19.28**, with Tyrone Tracy's **16.50** parked on his bench.

So: Devil Dogz **5-1**. Silver Stars, Dirty South and the Kahunas all **4-2**. Bird Gang and the Skidmarks **3-3**. Sponge Bobs, Mexican Mafia and Haven Boyz **2-4**. Brendawg21 **1-5**. Six of ten make the playoffs and there are eight games left, so nobody is dead yet, but Brendan should know his **614.04** points scored is the fifth-most in the league and the **711.40** he has allowed is the most anyone has surrendered. He is losing games he has no business losing. Meanwhile the Kahunas, who have never won this thing and own four toilet bowls, gave up **193.96** in week 1 and scored **54.02** in week 6, and somehow sit fourth. There is no justice in this league, only scheduling.

posts.title: The Devil Dogz Keep Winning the Wrong Way
posts.author: Commissioner
body: Jersey Devil Dogz are **5-0** and they got there Sunday by leaving their best quarterback on the bench. Jayden Daniels put up **32.26** in street clothes as far as Chubby's lineup was concerned, while Kyler Murray started and returned **19.26**. It did not matter. Ka'imi Fairbairn kicked **17**, Puka Nacua went for **20.7**, the Houston defense chipped in **15**, and the Dogz beat Mexican Mafia **124.86-100.34**. Alberto got **43.46** out of Drake Maye, which is **43 percent** of everything his team scored, and still lost by **24.52**. That is the Mexican Mafia experience in one line.

Silver Stars put up **161.40** on Brendawg21 and it was over before the late window. Jahmyr Gibbs **32.7**, Josh Allen **31.5**, Parker Washington **24.4**, Isaiah Likely **21.4** — four starters above twenty, which is not a thing this league does often. Justin's team has **658.06** points on the season, **72.16** more than anyone else, and sits **4-1**. Brendawg21 scored **117.02**, got **30.32** from Matthew Stafford, and fell to **0-5**. Here is the cruel part: Brendan has scored **510.06** points this year and the undefeated team has scored **498.60**. He is outscoring the only unbeaten franchise in the league by **11.46** and has nothing to show for it.

The defending champion lost again. Bird Gang scored **116.94** behind Jared Goff's **31.94** and Bucky Irving's **29.5** and watched Dirty South win it **125.30-116.94** on the back of Jaylen Warren's **30.8** and Joe Burrow's **28.6**. Chris Boswell added **13** off the kicker slot, which is usually where Erik's seasons go to die, not get saved. Bird Gang is **2-3** after a 14-0 regular season a year ago. The hangover is now officially longer than the party.

BIG Kahunas beat ShenHgts Skidmarks **128.48-104.04** and are **4-1**. Jacoby Brissett threw for **27.28**, Christian Watson went **26.3**, Spencer Shrader kicked **21**. Kyle has four toilet bowls, no titles, and the worst career record of anyone still in the league, and he is a game out of first. Mark's Skidmarks dropped to **3-2** with Dak Prescott managing **13.64** and Brandon Aubrey managing **5**. The elsewhere in the league was the Sponge Bobs over Haven Boyz, **86.66-70.42**, the only game all week where neither side cleared ninety. Zack's starting lineup produced **70.42** and he is **1-4**.

Six teams make the playoffs. Right now that is Jersey Devil Dogz, Silver Stars, BIG Kahunas, Dirty South, ShenHgts Skidmarks and Bird Gang, with Mexican Mafia on the outside at **2-3** and Sponge Bobs, Haven Boyz and Brendawg21 sorting out who gets measured for the toilet bowl. Nine weeks left. Haven Boyz have lost four straight and Brendawg21 have lost five, and neither streak is close to the nine Brendan himself posted in 2021 — the only real comfort available to either of them.

Nothing in the record book moved this week. Silver Stars' **161.40** was the eighth-best score in league history and the best anyone has managed since their own **193.96** in week 1, but it did not crack the all-time top five. The Devil Dogz' five-game run is still two short of the shortest streak on that list. Mostly what week 5 proved is that Chubby Ryan has not won a title since 2016 and is currently **5-0** with the seventh-most points in a ten-team league. Something has to give, and history says it will.

posts.title: Silver Stars Find the Floor
posts.author: Commissioner
body: Three weeks ago the Silver Stars put up **193.96**, the most points anyone has scored in a game in twenty-seven years of this league. On Sunday they managed **65.42**. That is a swing of **128.54** points in three weeks, and it was enough to lose to the ShenHgts Skidmarks **88.20** in a game neither team should want on film. Josh Allen led the Silver Stars with **19.52**. Kyle Monangai scored **27.0** on their bench, more than any Silver Stars starter, which is the sort of detail Justin will be hearing about in November. The Skidmarks did not play well either and did not need to. They are **3-1**.

The BIG Kahunas took Bird Gang **121.42-109.28** behind twin **26.7** games from Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams, and Spencer Shrader adding **16** from the kicker spot. Kenneth Walker went for **29.9** for Bird Gang, the second-highest starter score of the week, and it bought nothing. Bird Gang also left Jared Goff and his **21.48** on the bench to start Trevor Lawrence at **14.08**, which decided the game on its own. The defending champions are **2-2**. The Kahunas, who have never won anything, are **3-1**.

Mexican Mafia beat the Sponge Bobs **120.86-83.42** on two players: Tetairoa McMillan at **31.2** and Drake Maye at **30.16** combined for **61.36**, slightly more than half the roster's output. Dirty South posted the week's high at **125.42** to put away Haven Boyz **102.06**, with Joe Burrow, CeeDee Lamb and Nico Collins supplying **72.82** between them. Dirty South opened **0-2** and has now won two straight. Haven Boyz are **1-3** and started Rashee Rice for a zero.

Jersey Devil Dogz are the last unbeaten at **4-0** after handling Brendawg21 **102.38-84.68**. They have done it on **373.74** points, eighth-most in the league, which means Chubby has won four games without ever needing to be good. The franchise has six titles and none since 2016. Brendawg21, meanwhile, has scored **393.04** points — more than the unbeaten team — and sits **0-4**. The longest losing streak on record in this league is nine, set by this same franchise in 2021 under a different name. Four is not nine. It is a start.

Six of ten make the playoffs in week 15, so the standings are still mostly decoration, but the shape is there. Jersey Devil Dogz alone at **4-0**; Silver Stars, BIG Kahunas and ShenHgts Skidmarks at **3-1**; Bird Gang, Dirty South and Mexican Mafia at **2-2**; Haven Boyz at **1-3**; Brendawg21 and the Sponge Bobs at **0-4**. Ron's four-time champions have not won a game. The Silver Stars still lead the league in scoring at **496.66**, a pace that works out to roughly **1,738** over fourteen games, which would clear Bird Gang's record **1,585.54** from last season. Pace in week 4 is worth nothing. It is still there.

League-wide this was the quietest week of the year: **1,003.14** total points, an average of **100.31**, and a high score of **125.42** that is the lowest weekly high of the season. Nothing in the record book moved, and nothing came close. Ten teams, four games each, and the only franchise that has looked like itself is the one that scored 194 and then forgot how.

posts.title: Two Men, Thirteen Trophies
posts.author: Commissioner
body: Twenty-seven seasons. Twenty-seven trophies. **Erik Marnell has seven of them and Chubby Ryan has six.** That is 48% of every championship this league has ever handed out, won by two of the sixteen-odd people who have played in it.

Their methods could not be less alike. Chubby front-loaded his: **three straight from 2003 to 2005**, then three more in a four-year window from 2013 to 2016. He has not won since. Erik took his time — nothing until 2010, then **2010, 2011, 2012, 2017, 2020, 2022 and 2024**, a title roughly every other year for fifteen years, the most recent one two seasons ago.

Erik also owns three toilet bowls, which is the tell. Dirty South is 195-167-5 lifetime, the most wins in league history, and he still finds a way to bottom out every so often. Chubby has two. Nobody wins seven without occasionally losing badly.

The active chase: **Ron Wasilewski has four** and won as recently as 2021. **John Ryan Jr has three** — 2015, 2023, 2025 — and is the only man to win two of the last three. **Mark Mikita has 191 career wins, second-most all time, and exactly one title**, back in 2007 as the Purple Helmets. He also has four toilet bowls, tied with Kyle Ryan for the most anyone has taken. Twenty-five years, one ring, and the strangest résumé on the board.

posts.title: Fourteen and Oh
posts.author: Commissioner
body: There is no asterisk. **Bird Gang went 14-0**, took the first-round bye, won in week 16, and closed it out 108.18 to 79.96 over the ShenHgts Skidmarks. Sixteen games, sixteen wins, one trophy — and the only 100% regular season in twenty-seven years of this league.

The scary part is that it never really looked close. Bird Gang put up **1,585.54 points, the most any team has ever scored in a season**, breaking Dirty South's 1,576 from 2022. They also allowed the fewest points in the league that year, by a margin of 39.

It came within a quarter of a point of being ordinary. **Week 8 against the Jersey Devil Dogz finished 110.32 to 110.08** — a 0.24 margin. Flip one late catch and the whole thing is just a very good 13-1 season nobody writes about.

For the Skidmarks, second place extended one of the odder résumés in the league. Mark Mikita has **191 career wins, second-most of anyone**, and exactly one championship — 2007, back when the team was the Purple Helmets. He also has four toilet bowls, tied for the most. Twenty-five years in, that is a lot of football for one ring.

posts.title: Three of the Five Worst Days in League History
posts.author: Commissioner
body: The *Most Points Allowed — Game* table has five entries. **The Silver Stars are on it three times.**

First came 2021, when they gave up **170** — still the most points any team has surrendered in a single game in twenty-seven years. Then 2025 happened. In **week 16 the Mexican Mafia hung 163.00 on them, and in week 17, 165.14.** Back to back, same opponent, 328.14 points across fourteen days.
Both of those were consolation games. Neither decided anything.

The Mafia went 4-10 that year and are **75-91-3 lifetime**, and yet those two weeks are the highest-scoring games of the Sleeper era — fourth and fifth all time, behind Bird Gang's 170 in 2021 and Big Kahunas' 169 in 2019. It is not the first time the arithmetic has failed Alberto Ruiz. In **2021 the Mafia went 12-2**, matched since only by Dirty South in 2024 and beaten only by Bird Gang's perfect 2025 — and he did not win the title. Twelve seasons in: two toilet bowls, no rings.

The genre is well populated. **Silver Stars led the entire league in scoring in 2023** with 1,491.52 points and lost in the first round, 84.64 to 90.26. **Sponge Bobs scored the second-most points in the league in 2024** and went 7-7. Schedule luck is real and this league is the proof.
